Which Spartan is the hottest?
options: I don't rate guys by hotness.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, there is one `other` alternative...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there is one [color=#e23b3b][i]other[/i][/color] alternative...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `I` can teach you how to be a Spartan.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] can teach you how to be a Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You? Wait...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw man, is this going to involve 'bonding?'

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Just take my offer before I take it back!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Relax, relax. I take your offer.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Good. The next polo match is in two days... We'll need to have you ready by then.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why then?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because those guys are going to come at you again, `hard.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because those guys are going to come at you again, [color=#e23b3b][i]hard.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If you're not more Spartan by then, they'll provoke you into fighting, and you'll be expelled!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great. Can you turn me into a Spartan in two days?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't know... We'll have to get started tonight.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Meet me at `The Windsor Knot` in your nicest clothes.
nodes.text_bbcode: Meet me at [color=#e23b3b][i]The Windsor Knot[/i][/color] in your nicest clothes.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And shower beforehand...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: With soap!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And `'lather, rinse, repeat'` means...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]'lather, rinse, repeat'[/i][/color] means...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, `Mom!` I get it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#e23b3b][i]Mom![/i][/color] I get it!

nodes.text: Colt has failed.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look... All I know is that if you can't beat 'em... Or run from 'em...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's time to join 'em.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All I have to do is talk funny, figure out how you guys use those fencing swords...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And tell everyone that my dad is the President of England!
Colt starts to march off the field...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... Not so fast there.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Even if you were to correct your shockingly erroneous grasp of foreign governments, `becoming a Spartan` is more than just a cheap con.
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if you were to correct your shockingly erroneous grasp of foreign governments, [color=#e23b3b][i]becoming a Spartan[/i][/color] is more than just a cheap con.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: English, Tom?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It won't work. Those guys will see right through you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So what, then? I'm doomed no matter what I do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've just gotta keep out of their way, you know?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Quit this polo thing... Duck out of classes...
Tom reaches down from his horse and slaps Colt across the face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hiding is just another way of running from your problems, you Neanderthal!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't see what else I can do...
Colt shoves Tom aside, strides forward, and clocks Chad in the face, knocking him down!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You fool! Was it worth it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course! When is punching a slimy, rich guy `not` worth it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course! When is punching a slimy, rich guy [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] worth it?

nodes.text: Tom looks over at the approaching headmaster...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, how about... Now?
A few days later, Colt carries his things out of the pearl-encrusted gates of Spartan Academy.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you going to do now that you've been expelled?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not sure. There's no way to appeal the decision, is there?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: After your punch on the polo field... Doubtful.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And after your comment about the Headmaster's mother... Never!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Heh. `Rotund` is such a funny word.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. [color=#e23b3b][i]Rotund[/i][/color] is such a funny word.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Honestly, I can't believe I ever stood up for you. Good riddance!
Tom storms away.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tom, wait!
Tom doesn't turn back...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ah! Who needs this crummy school anyway?! I'm sure another school will take me!
A few hours later, on the steps of Monarch Prep, the prep school `for girls...`
nodes.text_bbcode: A few hours later, on the steps of Monarch Prep, the prep school [b]for girls...[/b]

nodes.text: Colt talks to Principal Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I'm not `technically` a girl, but I feel I can really enhance the experience here...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'm not [color=#e23b3b][i]technically[/i][/color] a girl, but I feel I can really enhance the experience here...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Get off the steps of my school, or I will use this broom to sweep you off!
Principal Whitford lunges forward, hitting Colt in the shoulder with her broom!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ow! Seriously? That hurt!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I said begone!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait! Please! Just hear me out!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Fine! You have ten seconds...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ten seconds?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Nine! Eight!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay! I'm charming! I'm handsome, obviously... Oh! And I already know the campus like the back of my hand so...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Excuse me? How could you possibly know this campus?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Guess I'm out of time, right?
Principal Whitford charges at Colt, sweeping at him with her broom!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Get off my steps, you scoundrel!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Yah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Looks like Colt's punch `wasn't` worth it, considering he can't find a school to take him in!
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like Colt's punch [b]wasn't[/b] worth it, considering he can't find a school to take him in!

nodes.text: Try again and see if you can keep your cool... And find your place at Spartan Academy!
Colt keeps his cool...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're good?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm good...
Just then, an older Spartan on a huge horse trots forward, eyeing Colt. After several moments of inspection...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And what, pray tell, is going on here?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We're just giving the new kid a bit of a hassle, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: And do you honestly think that's worth your time? I'm disappointed in you, Chad. Let's go.
Percy turns his horse away. The others follow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who was `that` guy?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That was Percy, aka Percival Von Guttentag. He's the crown prince of Ichstenborg.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Bless you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's a tiny little European nation that just so happens to have one of the wealthiest monarchies on the planet. The truth is, his family puts mine to shame.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ever since he was sent to Spartan, he's taken over the place. Everyone thinks he's just so cool and perfect...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Bitter much?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, you're not exactly helping things are you? I can't believe you embarrassed yourself like that!
Bucking him into the mud!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He swings, connecting with the ball and sending it flying forward!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha! Nailed it! Is there `nothing` I'm not the best at?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Nailed it! Is there [color=#e23b3b][i]nothing[/i][/color] I'm not the best at?!

nodes.text: Colt leans back triumphantly on his horse... Which causes it to rear onto its back legs...
He loses his balance!
Colt's horse neighs, rearing onto its back legs...
He hesitates!
Colt's horse neighs, rearing onto its back legs...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe... But at least I've got my youth.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Youth? Ha! I wouldn't trade one moment of my life for one year of yours!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, um, `I` wouldn't trade one moment of my life for a hundred years as a `butler!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, um, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] wouldn't trade one moment of my life for a hundred years as a [color=#e23b3b][i]butler![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I would much prefer to be a butler than a nobody.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Your problem, Jeeves, is that you don't realize that a butler `is` a nobody.
nodes.text_bbcode: Your problem, Jeeves, is that you don't realize that a butler [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a nobody.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I've served kings and noblemen! Who have you rubbed elbows with? Criminals and low-lifes?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Try beautiful girls who want to make out with me.
Jeeves pauses for the slightest moment...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I could not argue with that.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Nicely done, Colt!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Indeed. That was well-played, sir. And you kept your emotions out of the conversation...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I had good coaching...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You'll do just fine... Farewell.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, dummy! Take that back!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Er...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: No! And of the two of us, it is abundantly clear who `the dummy` is!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! And of the two of us, it is abundantly clear who [color=#e23b3b][i]the dummy[/i][/color] is!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You only prove my point further.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shut up! You... You suck, Jeeves!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: No... You are talking to one of the few remaining agents of Her Highness, the Queen.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I've put assassins twice your size into unbreakable chokeholds.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: `I` do not suck.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] do not suck.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grr!
Colt's fists clench. Tom steps in between Colt and Jeeves.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Calm down, Colt. Fighting Jeeves would be like trying to punch a sword!
Colt unclenches his fists...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm not going to fight Jeeves... I'm just... Disappointed.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I found this exercise equally disappointing, sir. You let your emotions cloud your judgment.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: And before things get any worse, I must take my leave of you...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you `trying` to waste my time?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you [color=#e23b3b][i]trying[/i][/color] to waste my time?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, it sure appears that way.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe you're just a bad teacher! Did you ever think of that?
Tom pauses and takes a deep breath...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, we're both upset because this didn't go as well as either of us had hoped...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Let's just move on...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's cool. As long as I don't have to spend any more time in Horsecrap Village.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That was `absolutely` atrocious.
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#e23b3b][i]absolutely[/i][/color] atrocious.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why would anyone even want to ride horses when there are motorcycles?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You don't see anyone flying on falcons anymore! You know why? Airplanes!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Please just stop talking, and let's get inside!
Tom rides up...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stop! Stop! Stop!
The horse does not obey, running right over a particular muddy patch of the field...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! Don't you dare! `Don't you dare!`

nodes.text: And he splashes down, coating himself in a wave of mud!

Tom gives Colt's horse a gentle whack on its hindquarters...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hyah!
The horse starts streaking down the field at a breakneck pace!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Yaaaaah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yaaaaah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt begins to slip in the saddle...
The grass whirs by in a blur!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stop, you stupid horse...
Colt applies pressure to his horse with his left leg...
Immediately, the horse turns to the right, keeping pace with Tom!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Excellent!
Ten incredibly frustrating minutes later...
Colt applies pressure to his horse with his right leg...
And the horse veers off to the left!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! Wrong way, $Horse!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't you know your right from your left?!
Tom calls from across the field...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't you know your right from your left?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grr!
Ten incredibly frustrating minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My... Arms?
Colt applies pressure to his horse with his arms!
The horse neighs, but doesn't change direction!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're supposed to steer it, not give it a massage!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Time to turn! Follow me!
Tom turns his horse to the right!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I need to apply pressure with my...
Colt squeezes the horse with his thighs.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ow. That is not comfortable.
The horse neighs angrily.

nodes.speaker: Colt

nodes.speaker: Colt

nodes.text: Did you get all that? Or shall I just keep repeating these instructions all day?

nodes.speaker: Tom

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I call Ben 'Tweed', so, it'll make me laugh every time I say my horse's name.

nodes.speaker: Colt

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm going to go with 'Autumn'.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You sure?

nodes.text: Yeah... Autumn makes me think of leaves changing colors, and well, I'm trying to turn over a new leaf, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is this what insight is? I was always curious...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think I'm going to stick with 'Grampy' here.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: On what basis?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I learned from a cop in SF about following my gut...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And my gut says 'Grampy' is the horse for me!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If 'Grampy' is your gut's choice, then I'm certain you're actually following indigestion...

nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I think the salesman was offended by your behavior!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're wearing a lei!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I knew he was lying when he told me this was the `new` double-breasted sport coat!
nodes.text_bbcode: I knew he was lying when he told me this was the [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] double-breasted sport coat!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's no surprise! What's wrong with you? You couldn't be nice to him for one second?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Did you hear what he called me? He's lucky I didn't cave his face in!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I should have known you couldn't be polite! Change back and meet me out front!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Glad to be done with that place.

nodes.text: Completely what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I lost my train of thought...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Well, stop wasting my time!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay, fine, I'm going to make this blunt. I have a `lot` of money, and I'm not above a bribe. Now will you help us?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look, I'm afraid you'll have to forgive my friend and his attire...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: And I'm afraid that his attire is `unforgivable,` Mr. Prince.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm afraid that his attire is [color=#e23b3b][i]unforgivable,[/i][/color] Mr. Prince.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! You're...
Tom nudges Colt with his elbow.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That is... What I meant to say... Is that you're completely...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: 'Har har'? I don't understand... Is that some kind of fish sauce?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, it's me letting you know that your joke isn't funny!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Thank you! I did think it was rather clever.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Is your friend all right?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... He's just making a joke, you know? Doing his best rabies impression! Ha ha, Colt! Classical!

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: I find your friend's brand of humor rather tasteless!
The salesman turns to Tom.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: How can I help `you,` Mr. Prince?
nodes.text_bbcode: How can I help [color=#e23b3b][i]you,[/i][/color] Mr. Prince?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We'd like to get Colt fitted for something formal...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: And has he gotten all his shots?

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I didn't know about the dress code... Otherwise, I would have worn something nicer.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: I dare not imagine...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: What did you say?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He said... Why don't you `soak` on a `ring?` It's something poor people do for good luck! How silly and superstitious they are!
nodes.text_bbcode: He said... Why don't you [color=#e23b3b][i]soak[/i][/color] on a [color=#e23b3b][i]ring?[/i][/color] It's something poor people do for good luck! How silly and superstitious they are!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Isn't that right, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Hmmph!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Why don't I `what?`

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing.
After the longest shower of his life, Colt meets Tom outside of `The Windsor Knot,` a high-end clothing store for men.
nodes.text_bbcode: After the longest shower of his life, Colt meets Tom outside of [b]The Windsor Knot,[/b] a high-end clothing store for men.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Hey, Richie.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: What on earth are you wearing?!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You said to wear my nicest outfit!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Then why are you wearing the same raggedy clothes I always see you in?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Did you not notice this?
Colt lifts up his tank top, exposing a belt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you insane? Do you think you'll be allowed into `The Windsor Knot` dressed like an escaped convict?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you insane? Do you think you'll be allowed into [color=#e23b3b][i]The Windsor Knot[/i][/color] dressed like an escaped convict?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Do you see any orange on me?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, they're not going to let you in like `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, they're not going to let you in like [color=#e23b3b][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hold up... You're telling me that in order to buy fancy pants at this fancy-pants store, I have to already `own` a pair of fancy pants?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hold up... You're telling me that in order to buy fancy pants at this fancy-pants store, I have to already [color=#e23b3b][i]own[/i][/color] a pair of fancy pants?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes! It's called a dress code!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, I'm going to have fun here...
Colt starts to barge into the store, but Tom stops him.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Whoa! Look, I `might` be able to get the staff to turn a blind eye to your appearance...
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! Look, I [color=#e23b3b][i]might[/i][/color] be able to get the staff to turn a blind eye to your appearance...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But if we go in there, you have to abide by `my` rules.
nodes.text_bbcode: But if we go in there, you have to abide by [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] rules.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I am `not` going to blow-dry my hair!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] going to blow-dry my hair!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Do you want my aid or not?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Depends. What are your rules?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: There's only one for now... You have to be polite to the sales staff!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Polite? Wait, wait... I thought you Spartan guys got your kicks talking `down` to 'commoners?'
nodes.text_bbcode: Polite? Wait, wait... I thought you Spartan guys got your kicks talking [color=#e23b3b][i]down[/i][/color] to 'commoners?'

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Absolutely! It is our duty to remind everyone of our superior status! But the salesmen here are `not` commoners.
nodes.text_bbcode: Absolutely! It is our duty to remind everyone of our superior status! But the salesmen here are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] commoners.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: They are like royal artists. And their art is matching worthy men with perfect suits.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If they're going to help us, we'll need to be in their good graces.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why don't we just go to some `other` dumb store for rich people?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't we just go to some [color=#e23b3b][i]other[/i][/color] dumb store for rich people?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because... There is only `one Windsor Knot.` If you want to become a true Spartan, this is where you shop. `Nowhere` else.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because... There is only [color=#e23b3b][i]one Windsor Knot.[/i][/color] If you want to become a true Spartan, this is where you shop. [color=#e23b3b][i]Nowhere[/i][/color] else.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right. Got it. You're nuts.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Remind me again, why do we have to be nice to these guys? I mean, isn't it their `job` to help us?
nodes.text_bbcode: Remind me again, why do we have to be nice to these guys? I mean, isn't it their [color=#e23b3b][i]job[/i][/color] to help us?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It is their job to help people who look like me. `You,` on the other hand, look like the bottom of a dumpster.
nodes.text_bbcode: It is their job to help people who look like me. [color=#e23b3b][i]You,[/i][/color] on the other hand, look like the bottom of a dumpster.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You'll be lucky if they even speak to you, so be polite! Or whatever your impression of polite looks like...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine.
Colt and Tom step into `The Windsor Knot`. Within a few seconds, a finely-dressed man approaches.
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt and Tom step into [b]The Windsor Knot[/b]. Within a few seconds, a finely-dressed man approaches.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Mr. Prince, how delightful!
The salesman eyes Colt with repugnance.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: And I see you brought... Something.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This is my friend and roommate, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: A fitting name, indeed. I thought I smelled something... Equinal.

nodes.speaker: Snooty Salesman
nodes.text: Well, Mr. Colt, I'm gleefully afraid we don't allow violators of our dress code in here.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, why don't you...

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Still no uniform?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I think I liked you better when your clothes were caked in mud. Less offensive to the eye.
Chad happily rides off!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hate that guy.
A few moments later, the match begins...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, $Horse! Let's do this!
Colt plays very well, swiftly steering his horse after the ball and scoring a couple of goals!
After the match, Chad and the other Spartans confront Colt and Tom in the locker room!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I see what you and Tom are up to!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Just because you've gotten a couple of tips about riding a horse, that doesn't make you a Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, Chad...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Actually, Tom, I've got this...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Spartans are king-like warriors. And polo is considered to be the sport of kings. Therefore...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I kinda think it `does` qualify me for being a Spartan.
nodes.text_bbcode: I kinda think it [color=#e23b3b][i]does[/i][/color] qualify me for being a Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Nice use of the transitive property.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Preston! Don't compliment him! He can't even spell 'transitive!'
Chad turns to Colt, jabbing a finger at his chest.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You don't belong here! You're a nothing! And you always will be!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What's your problem, Chad?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: He's a fake! An imitation of a Spartan! I earned my spot!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: My father is rich! My mom's a Senator! What about his parents? Huh?
Chad gets right in Colt's face...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: They're probably just a bunch of nothings. Just like you.
Colt's fists clench...
And unclench!
He turns his back to Chad and resumes dressing.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey! I'm still talking to you!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Just leave him alone, Chad.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Don't tell me you're on his side now too!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, Colt! I'm not done with you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, but I'm done with you...
Chad shoves Colt in the back, slamming him into the locker.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt looks at Tom questioningly...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is `this` the place for fighting?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] the place for fighting?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This? `Definitely.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This? [color=#e23b3b][i]Definitely.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Chad winds up for a punch, but before he can throw it, Colt spins and decks him!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Ooh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ooh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Chad sprawls onto the floor!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I played your game your way and 'won'.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now you played your game my way and 'lost'.
Just then, there is the sound of soft clapping. Colt looks over to see the older Spartan standing in the corner.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Bravo.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Am I entertaining you?

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Greatly.

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: Before, I said you weren't worth our time...

nodes.speaker: Percy
nodes.text: But now I stand corrected... `Spartan.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But now I stand corrected... [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: He walks away... The other Spartans follow.
That evening, Tom and Colt relax in their dorm room.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm really proud of you, Colt. You managed to be yourself `and` be a Spartan too!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm really proud of you, Colt. You managed to be yourself [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] be a Spartan too!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Someone had to bring you guys down to the gutter... Why not me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And what was the deal with that Percy guy? First he's all 'You're not worth my time', and then he's all 'You `are` worth my time'...
nodes.text_bbcode: And what was the deal with that Percy guy? First he's all 'You're not worth my time', and then he's all 'You [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] worth my time'...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that, like, a European thing?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's a pompous blowhard thing. Now that you're on your way towards popularity, he wants to make sure he has you on his side.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, you jealous? Don't you worry your dear, little head... You'll always be `my` favorite spoiled rich dude.
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw, you jealous? Don't you worry your dear, little head... You'll always be [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] favorite spoiled rich dude.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Har har.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey... Can I ask you a personal question?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know... Does it involve grooming?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: When we were up at that ski lodge, you mentioned you were dealing with some girl drama... Did that ever get resolved?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Not really.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, it's kind of a long story. See, after we parted ways, I went to San Francisco and...
Just then, there's the sound of footsteps outside their door! The door rattles for a moment...
And then a letter slides underneath!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What the...?
Colt walks over and picks it up, examining it against the light.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Some kind of letter. It's got this weird seal on it, like a lightning bolt...
Tom's face goes white. His eyes open wide with disbelief.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh... My...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Did you just say... A `lightning bolt?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you just say... A [color=#e23b3b][i]lightning bolt?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: What could this mysterious letter be?! Find out in the next `Surviving High School!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What could this mysterious letter be?! Find out in the next [b]Surviving High School![/b]

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Just then, a gothy-looking guy walks up to them.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, you guys are Spartans, right?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Indeed.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's it to you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm Nick. I'm a Spartan too.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Really? I've never seen you before.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We don't really run in the same circles. I'm not really into polo... The horse or the shirt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think I like this guy.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I was just wondering if I could take a picture.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Nothing creepy. It's for the yearbook... I'm sort of into photography.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure. Go ahead.
Nick takes out a bulky, expensive camera and snaps a picture of Tom and Colt.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks, guys! I really appreciate it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No problem... Hey, you're not like most Spartans. How come Chad and his goons don't pick on you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's kind of a funny thing, but when you're always behind a camera, no one seems to notice you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hmmm...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Anyway, keep on... Doing whatever it is you were doing!
Nick leaves.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I'm not going to hide behind a big camera... How would chicks see my face?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Good. Tomorrow morning we continue your Spartan training.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh joy. What's next? Learning tax loopholes?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Just meet me at the stables!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The stables?
Early the next morning, Colt meets Tom at the stables.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing wakes me up in the morning more than smelling a brewing hot pot of horse crap.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, you'll have to endure it. With your pathetic horsemanship, you'll never be a proper Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! I can ride! I just got stuck with a dumb horse last time!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Which brings me to the next lesson in your training... Choosing the right horse!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sounds easy enough.
Colt walks along the horse stalls and stands in front of one of the horses.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This one looks good. I feel more Spartan-y already.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You just chose a horse named 'Grampy'!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So? It could be an ironic name... Like a big guy named 'Tiny' or something.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Horses aren't named ironically, and their names are often a reliable indicator of personality...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You don't want a horse on its last legs... You want a horse that matches who you are...
Tom walks down the row of stalls...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Let's see... This one's called `Tweed Killer.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's see... This one's called [color=#e23b3b][i]Tweed Killer.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This one's called `Captain Escape.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This one's called [color=#e23b3b][i]Captain Escape.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This one's called `High and Mighty.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This one's called [color=#e23b3b][i]High and Mighty.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And this one's called `Autumn.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And this one's called [color=#e23b3b][i]Autumn.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know which one I want. I'll take...
Later... After the horses have been returned to the stables...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I think that use of colorful language is a fitting segue into the final and most challenging task of turning you into a Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I hope you're talking about making me rich, 'cause if so, I'm there.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Making you rich would be easy compared to this...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It would? Then why are we doing `this?`
nodes.text_bbcode: It would? Then why are we doing [color=#e23b3b][i]this?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The final task is to get you to `speak` like a Spartan Man...
nodes.text_bbcode: The final task is to get you to [color=#e23b3b][i]speak[/i][/color] like a Spartan Man...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nuh-uh. I don't think so. All you guys talk like you've got sticks up your...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ahem!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wordplay is a Spartan's greatest `asset.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wordplay is a Spartan's greatest [color=#e23b3b][i]asset.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: After you've cleaned up, meet us in the commons area...
Tom heads off toward campus...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Us?` Who's us?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Us?[/i][/color] Who's us?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And why are you always telling me to clean up?!
After another long shower, Colt meets Tom in the commons area...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's up, Richie?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In order to properly educate you on manners of speech, I've enlisted the most silver-tongued man I know...
Suddenly Tom's butler, Jeeves, is standing next to Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gah!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance yet again, sir.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Where did you `come` from?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Where did you [color=#e23b3b][i]come[/i][/color] from?!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I am a master in many arts. Most notably service, eloquence, and military surveillance tactics.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... That's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Tom informs me of your intentions to speak like a gentleman, to master the field of verbal fencing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yup! I want to stick it to those morons and their big dumb butts!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Oh dear.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Can you help him, Jeevesy?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: My skeptical boy, I've transformed nose-pickers into heads of state! I can handle `him!`
nodes.text_bbcode: My skeptical boy, I've transformed nose-pickers into heads of state! I can handle [color=#e23b3b][i]him![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jeeves turns to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: The real issue is to get your mind out of the gutter and into the Gruyere, so to speak.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is that like a fancy toilet?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Put another way... You must learn to choose the higher path.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I do that by...?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I'll explain...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: If Tom were to tell me that I was nothing but a common servant...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I could respond obviously and call him a pompous ignoramus who wouldn't know a hard day's work if it bit him on the posterior!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Slam! That's gotta sting, Tom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Plus, more good news, now I know what a posterior is!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm overjoyed.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Or I could respond the `Spartan` way and tell him that I'd rather be a common servant than a common man.
nodes.text_bbcode: Or I could respond the [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan[/i][/color] way and tell him that I'd rather be a common servant than a common man.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: All I have to do to stop being common is quit being his servant. He, unfortunately, cannot quit being himself.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa... It's like you insulted him...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Except you didn't...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Except you `did!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Except you [color=#e23b3b][i]did![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You'll notice I come across a great deal more dignified the Spartan way.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think I get it...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Very well, then let's put you to the test!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... The test?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: `Me.` I'm going to insult you, and you have to respond the Spartan way.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Me.[/i][/color] I'm going to insult you, and you have to respond the Spartan way.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... But I'm pretty sure you've got me beat.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: My boy, if you manage to scrape together even the smallest assault against me, you'll do quite fine against those Spartan dullards.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Just make sure you don't let your emotions get to you.
Jeeves cricks his neck ever so slightly.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: We begin.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You are a whiny, insignificant, waffling brat of a boy!
In an instant, Jeeves is gone.
Colt turns to Tom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I just want to say...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know that sucked, but I still want to say...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks, Tom... For trying to Spartan me up these last two days...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Embarrassed `myself?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Embarrassed [color=#e23b3b][i]myself?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait wait `wait...` Does everyone but me think I `lost` just now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait wait [color=#e23b3b][i]wait...[/i][/color] Does everyone but me think I [color=#e23b3b][i]lost[/i][/color] just now?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: By a landslide, you rube.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How? They're the ones wearing goofy outfits, galloping `away` from a fight...
nodes.text_bbcode: How? They're the ones wearing goofy outfits, galloping [color=#e23b3b][i]away[/i][/color] from a fight...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not to mention that Chad guy didn't have `one` comeback from the crack I made about his mom.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not to mention that Chad guy didn't have [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] comeback from the crack I made about his mom.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Maybe that's because Chad's mom is a `Senator.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe that's because Chad's mom is a [color=#e23b3b][i]Senator.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Is she hot?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why would that be your first instinct?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Who cares? If you continue this way, you're bound to get into another altercation!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Only I won't be around to save your hide.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You'll be expelled before that low-brow brain of yours knows what hit it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And you'll have completely `wasted` my gift... All the money I've given you for your tuition!
nodes.text_bbcode: And you'll have completely [color=#e23b3b][i]wasted[/i][/color] my gift... All the money I've given you for your tuition!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, Tom, I'm grateful that you fronted all that dough, believe me. But that Chad guy is right about one thing...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This isn't a place for someone like me.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So you're going to run from your problems yet again?! Did you learn nothing from our snowbound sortie?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I learned that you talk like a thesaurus.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I am talking about...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know, I know. I'm just having fun with you, Silver Spoon.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So... You're not running?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No. I'm done with that. And that means all I can do is...
Colt notices the headmaster scowling at him from the sidelines...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You're lucky Tom was here to prevent you from entering into fisticuffs with me.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: It would have been fun knocking your teeth out right before you got expelled!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're rather welcome!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But there isn't any more time for pleasantries! The polo match starts soon!
A few minutes later, Colt and Tom are sitting atop their horses on the polo field.
Chad rides by...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm concerned for your prospects.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You are?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I haven't seen very much evidence that you've made `any` progress, Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: I haven't seen very much evidence that you've made [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] progress, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, that's great! Real supportive, Tom!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm just calling them like I see them!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Give me a chance, man! Have faith!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The polo match is in a few hours! Are you suddenly going to transform into a Spartan?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Watch me!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The library! If you won't teach me how to be a gentleman, I'll figure it out on my own!
Colt marches off in the direction of the library...
A few hours later...
Colt trots his horse out onto the field...
Holding a long jousting lance!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you out of your mind?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I did a lot of reading, Tom! This is how gentlemen get even!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, $Horse! Hyah!
Colt gallops toward Chad, aiming his lance for Chad's chest!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What the...?
Colt knocks him off his horse! The crowd gasps!
As Chad struggles to his feet, Colt dismounts, sprints over, and punches him back down into the mud!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That felt `so` good!
nodes.text_bbcode: That felt [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] good!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: `For Spartan! Ahhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]For Spartan! Ahhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A mob of angry Spartans charges at Colt, tackling him into the mud!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Yahhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yahhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Soon, Colt is trying to fight off Carson, Percy, `and` Preston at the same time...
nodes.text_bbcode: Soon, Colt is trying to fight off Carson, Percy, [b]and[/b] Preston at the same time...

nodes.text: Chad rises to his feet and cracks his knuckles...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... I can handle three of you! But not a fourth!
Tom comes running up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tom, you got my back?
Tom rolls up his sleeves...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Atta boy, Tom! It'll be just like when we took down Hawk and his bros!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm afraid not, Colt. I'm a Spartan. And it looks like you `aren't.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm afraid not, Colt. I'm a Spartan. And it looks like you [color=#e23b3b][i]aren't.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You mean... You're with them?
Tom nods...
The Spartans close in around Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Gulp!
Looks like Colt's outnumbered!
Play again and see if you can keep him from punching his way out of school!

Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: As the groundskeepers try to round up Colt's horse, Chad and several Spartans trot up to Colt...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Enjoying the mud? Seems like you're right at home!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Honestly, I don't know if you should wash those clothes or simply burn them.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Seriously, man, `where` did you get those?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! Seriously, man, [color=#e23b3b][i]where[/i][/color] did you get those?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: He can't help it! He probably thinks a sport coat is a coat you play tennis in!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha ha! Stop it, guys! I'm going to fall off my horse from laughing so hard!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: By the way, where'd you even find that horse? It's such a hideous animal!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, it reminded me of your mom!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What? How does that make sense?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: A horse and a human are entirely different species...
Colt extricates himself from the mud...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Do me a favor and stay out of my sight.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: In case you haven't noticed, you don't really belong at Spartan...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: So why don't you run back home to whatever shack you crawled out of and have a nice can of cold beans with your worthless family?
Colt lunges at Chad, yanking him down from his horse!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Aaaah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aaaah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He cocks his fist back for a punch...
But Tom pulls him off!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let go of me, Tom!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This isn't the place for a fight!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah, well, where is?! You tell me, because this guy's got a date with my fists!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, I recommend canceling the date, because right now, you're in the middle of the polo field with the headmaster watching!
Colt notices the headmaster scowling at him from the sidelines...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You're lucky Tom was here to prevent you from entering into fisticuffs with me.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: It would have been fun knocking your teeth out right before you got expelled!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: At least I hit the stupid ball...
Colt mounts his horse, settling into the saddle and...
The horse doesn't seem to mind!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And you thought I was going to get bucked off, didn't you, Silver Spoon?
Colt's horse neighs playfully!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Very good, Colt. We might make a rider out of you yet!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, what's next?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, there is the matter of actually getting the horse to move.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh. Yeah. How do I do that?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We're running out of time, so I'm going to have to give you the quick and dirty version...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's the version I like best...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Just pay attention...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Go forward by squeezing the horse with `your calves...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Go forward by squeezing the horse with [color=#e23b3b][i]your calves...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Turn the horse by applying pressure with the leg that is `opposite` the direction you want to go.
nodes.text_bbcode: Turn the horse by applying pressure with the leg that is [color=#e23b3b][i]opposite[/i][/color] the direction you want to go.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And lastly, stop the horse by saying, `'Whoa!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: And lastly, stop the horse by saying, [color=#e23b3b][i]'Whoa!'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Got it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Whoa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoa![/i][/color]

nodes.text: ...And sends Colt flying into a pool of mud!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why is there mud everywhere on this campus?!

nodes.subtitle: Can Colt become a true Spartan?

nodes.text: As morning shines on the extravagant campus of Spartan Academy, Colt and Tom approach the front gate.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're sure about paying for my tuition, Fancypants? This school looks like it's made out of `gold.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're sure about paying for my tuition, Fancypants? This school looks like it's made out of [color=#e23b3b][i]gold.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: These days, that's only partially true, but, you know... The economy.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And yes, I'm sure. After we battled together against Hawk Gunner, it's the least I could do.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If `the least` you could do is shell out this much cash, then you're buying all our pizza, roomie.
nodes.text_bbcode: If [color=#e23b3b][i]the least[/i][/color] you could do is shell out this much cash, then you're buying all our pizza, roomie.

nodes.text: Tom groans...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'd forgotten that we're going to be roommates together... Please tell me that you know how to keep things clean.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure. When the dishes get moldy, you just eat your food right out of the plastic container.
Tom groans again...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look... This gift of yours means a lot to me. Not only are you paying through the nose, but you're also giving me a chance to start fresh.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Anyway, uh, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't mention it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait... Are you being modest?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, seriously, `don't` mention it!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, seriously, [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] mention it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm not exactly top dog around here anymore. If word got out that I'd used my money for... Charity... Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Even Chad, my confidant, my right-hand man, my espresso fetcher, has forsaken me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tough life...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That reminds me... What `do` you guys do for kicks around here?
nodes.text_bbcode: That reminds me... What [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] you guys do for kicks around here?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Come with me.
Twenty minutes later...
On the polo grounds, several horse-mounted Spartans vie for control of a wooden ball...
Meanwhile, at the opposite end of the grounds...
Colt is sitting atop a horse that isn't moving at all!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Lazy! The ball's way over there! Mush!
The horse snorts.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't give me attitude!
Tom rides up on his own horse.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm not sure if someone with your upbringing is aware of this...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But riding a horse should be a `faster` mode of transport than walking.
nodes.text_bbcode: But riding a horse should be a [color=#e23b3b][i]faster[/i][/color] mode of transport than walking.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Professor Obvious, good tip!
Colt grabs his horse's ear and twists it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on you stupid thing! `Rev!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on you stupid thing! [color=#e23b3b][i]Rev![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The horse shakes off Colt's grip, annoyed.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It isn't a motorcycle, you imbecile!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it didn't come with a manual!
Suddenly the ball comes their way. Colt's horse stirs...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right! Finally! Lazy's got some life in him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now if I could just get close enough to knock out one of the other riders with this mallet thing!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... That's not supposed to be used as a weapon!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm kidding, Richie! Relax!
Nearby, Chad hits the ball with his mallet...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: `Hyah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hyah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: ...Knocking it right to Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I got this!
Colt pulls his mallet back, poised for a mighty swing...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Very funny, guys.
Colt and Tom step out of the store...

nodes.text: Yeah, well, maybe it was my greatest challenge too.

nodes.text: I'm enthused to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll be enthused if we can come back here and egg this place.

nodes.text: The stopping part could use work...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But overall you did rather splendid.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.text: There's a thought that makes me want to barf...
